Record Class TunnelSnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.despical.portbridge.tunnel.TunnelSnapshot
public record TunnelSnapshot(TunnelState state, String address, String localAddress, Instant connectedAt, int reconnectAttempt, Instant nextRetryAt, long latencyMillis, String detail, String lastError) extends Record
Provides an immutable view of the current tunnel for commands and notifications.

The worker publishes snapshots after lifecycle and route-check updates. Readers can retain a snapshot across threads without accessing the native process. Connection and retry timestamps may be absent; negative latency means no public ping measurement is available. An allocated address alone does not verify a route.
